The cucumber is elongated and cylindrical with a distinctively bumpy, spiny green skin (typical of certain varieties like gherkins or pickling cucumbers). It is surrounded by large green leaves and thin tendrils. The lighting is bright, creating strong highlights on the upper surface of the fruit and deep shadows underneath. The background is blurred foliage.
